title: 6.4 A 400×400 3.24μm 117dB-Dynamic-Range 3-Layer Stacked Digital Pixel Sensor
problem: AR/VR glasses and compact cameras require small pixel sizes with HDR capture and low power consumption; existing 2-layer stacked DPS at larger pixels cannot meet form-factor demands while supporting AI/CV processing.
motivation: AR/VR/metaverse applications demand extremely compact cameras (<2.5mm^2 die) with global shutter, HDR capability, and computational imaging. 3-layer stacking enables integration of ISP, frame averaging, and sparse transmission for AI/CV tasks within tight power budgets.
method: The sensor stacks three layers of light-detecting semiconductors into each pixel, with 10-bit memory (SRAM) built into each pixel to store measurements. To capture both bright and dark details in one shot, each pixel independently controls how long it measures light—a technique called per-pixel exposure time control. The chip includes image processing circuits that average frames to reduce noise and correct fixed pattern noise (systematic errors that repeat in every image). It transmits only important pixel data to AI processors, reducing power use.
key_novelty: The core innovation is stacking three semiconductor layers in each pixel with built-in memory (SRAM) and image processing (ISP), achieving a tiny 3.24μm pixel that captures an extremely wide brightness range (117dB dynamic range) in a single photograph.
contributions: 3.24μm pixel size via single-ended comparator and optimized control logic
117dB dynamic range (51-bit effective) via single-exposure HDR
On-die FAU and ISP for fixed-pattern noise correction and image enhancement
Sparse transmission for AI/CV inference with low power consumption
Compact 2.47×1.85mm^2 die suitable for AR/VR form factors

metrics.power: low power consumption (exact value not specified)

baselines: 2-layer stacked DPS (larger pixel size, less integration)
limitations: Abstract does not provide frame rate, power consumption in mW, noise performance (read noise), or specific AI/CV benchmark results.
primary_theme: Ultra-compact 3-layer stacked image sensor with on-die ISP and sparse transmission
